questiontext.text:
🚜 Bumper Crop Battleships

Somewhere in this field of {#N*N#} plots are three hidden bumper-crop patches. You have {#SHOTS#} shots. Each shot measures the crop yield in one plot.

  • Yields rise by 5 units for every step closer to the centre of a patch. Far from every patch the soil is poor, and yields are low.
  • Hit the centre of a patch (its highest plot) to score a ★ HIT.
  • So every shot tells you something: a low yield means you are far away, a higher one means you are getting closer. Follow the rise!
  • After your last shot, the whole field is revealed.

generalfeedback.text: Each bumper-crop patch raises the yield by 5 units for every step closer to its centre, down to poor soil of {@base-10@} far from every patch. Note, too, that shots aimed at high yields are not a random sample: they show far more high yields than the field really has.

truefeedback.text: ★★★ You found all three bumper crops!
★★ You found two of the three bumper crops.
★ You found one of the three bumper crops.

falsefeedback.text: No bumper crops found this time. When a shot is higher than poor soil, try the neighbouring plots and follow the rise in yield.
